outcome: type of anesthesia used for cesarean section
cohort: Patients undergoing cesarean section (elective and emergency) at Sir Ganga Ram Hospital Lahore from April 2015 to March 2016 (elective) and December 2015 to April 2016 (emergency).
finding: Spinal anesthesia was the most common anesthetic technique used for both elective (90.36%) and emergency (94.75%) cesarean sections.
